title: A-A pair at rest, separation 2.0 to 2.75, T <= 0.6: the P-0026 pair law with no clamp predicts positions to 0.006

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation in [2.0, 2.75], both at least 2.0 from every chamber wall, observed for at most T = 0.6: each particle accelerates toward the other with magnitude (G/2)/r^P, r the current separation, G = 23.63 and P = 2.099 (the P-0026 pair law), with no separation clamp. Measured tracker positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.006 of the chamber side. Extends P-0032 (separation 2.0 to 2.5) to 2.75. Not claimed: separation above 2.75, duration above 0.6 (a pair at initial separation 2.0 is at about 0.5 by t = 0.6 and is not validated through contact), other species, three or more particles, or initial velocities.
